description: P0-07 unit contract for implementation core development-loop behaviors.

metadata.title: implementation unit behaviors
metadata.description: Single-skill unit scenarios for implementation. Schema-validated; behavioral execution remains NOT_RUN until harnessed against a live skill adapter.

target_capability.description: Given authoritative inputs, implementation produces the expected governance/routing behaviors.
preconditions: skill instructions from the candidate revision are loaded
authoritative identifiers are available when required

scenarios.input: A ready work item has a current accepted plan, no open merge candidate, and the project ownership policy shows it unclaimed.
expected_behaviors: require the explicit work_item_id
complete read-only governance preflight
acquire and re-read the project-defined claim before edits
follow the accepted plan
handoff to host/project merge-candidate creation or resolution, then pr-review

scenarios.input: The work item is already claimed by developer-x while the current implementer is developer-y.
expected_behaviors: stop before branch/worktree/files/production edits
return BLOCKED
report the current owner when available

scenarios.input: The work item is ready and planned. An open merge candidate already exists with candidate_lifecycle_stage IN_REVIEW, and the user asks to fix reviewer comments on it.
expected_behaviors: require candidate_lifecycle_stage IN_REVIEW before review remediation
do not create a second implementation path
route to address-pr-review for the existing merge candidate
forbidden_behaviors: use new implementation workflow to patch review comments

scenarios.input: Implementation is complete and no merge candidate exists yet.
expected_behaviors: return a host/project merge-candidate creation or resolution handoff
do not invent a merge_candidate_id
route to pr-review only after a concrete candidate exists

criteria.criterion: Handoff creates or resolves the candidate

scenarios.input: The current developer owns work item WI-42, whose tracker state is IN_PROGRESS after implementation began. An open authorized PR for WI-42 already exists, implementation is incomplete, the accepted plan is still current, and the request is to continue feature implementation rather than address reviewer comments.
expected_behaviors: accept the authorized IN_PROGRESS-equivalent state for resume rather than requiring the tracker label READY
resume implementation on the same existing candidate
re-verify current ownership, accepted plan revision, acceptance, dependencies, and authority
do not create a second candidate
remain in implementation until the accepted scope is complete
forbidden_behaviors: block merely because the work item is no longer labeled READY
block merely because an open candidate exists
route to address-pr-review without review-remediation intent

scenarios.name: IMPL-006
scenarios.input: The current developer owns WI-42 with an open authorized draft PR. Accepted-scope implementation is still incomplete (candidate_lifecycle_stage=IMPLEMENTATION_IN_PROGRESS). Required CI is failing and a reviewer left early comments. The request is to continue the feature and clear the failures.
expected_behaviors: keep candidate_lifecycle_stage as IMPLEMENTATION_IN_PROGRESS
remain in implementation for unfinished scope and CI or early-feedback fixes
do not hand off to full merge-readiness pr-review yet
do not use address-pr-review as the primary route while implementation is incomplete
forbidden_behaviors: route to full pr-review while implementation is incomplete
treat early CI or comments as forcing address-pr-review then pr-review

scenarios.input: WI-42 has an open merge candidate whose candidate_lifecycle_stage is UNKNOWN. The user asks to continue implementation.
expected_behaviors: stop before branch, worktree, file, or production edits
return BLOCKED with next_action reconcile-candidate-stage
do not choose implementation, address-pr-review, or pr-review
